claims.text:
The meaning of the name Orgulas is unknown. J.R.R. Tolkien noted that the names of the Bucklanders had a vaguely Celtic style.
Jim Allan noted that the adjective orgulous ("proud", "haughty"), an anglisized form of a French word corresponding to orgeilleux in Modern French, is used by Malory in Le Morte Darthur. There it is used as a title of a Knight of the Round Table named Bellyance le Orgulus.
